existingSnapshot.localRetention: Existing explicit 7 or 30 days; no extension from reopen or this decision

A_dataClassificationAndRetention.commonRule: Before any production write, require dataClass, Subject, Account custodian, purpose, jurisdiction, source/version refs, approvedRetentionEndAt, approving role/person, lawful-basis/contract reference and deletion/hold policy version. Null or unresolved fields block storage; no permanent default.

classes.retain: Only authorized source scope and exact immutable source refs/digests; private payload only if separately permitted.
classes.basis: Verified source permission, purpose, applicable jurisdiction and client contract.
classes.term: Explicit approvedRetentionEndAt required; no duration invented.

classes.retain: Authorized source versions, applicable rule/output version, locale and review boundary; source facts and derived output remain distinct.
classes.basis: Permitted derived use and any independently approved delivery record class.
classes.term: Explicit approvedRetentionEndAt; no automatic extension beyond permitted source use; conflicting source/delivery retention requires review.

classes.retain: Source context, candidate options, separately recorded decision/approval/execution/outcome evidence; never fabricate missing stages.
classes.basis: Explicit processing/persistence purpose and decision-authority scope.
classes.term: Explicit approvedRetentionEndAt; reopen does not reset expiry.

classes.retain: Only actual independently authorized action/approval/execution/outcome records, if such a separate system exists. Current local candidate options do not create them.
classes.basis: Actual action responsibility, applicable contract and permitted record keeping.
classes.term: Explicit class-specific approvedRetentionEndAt before any formal record.

classes.retain: Minimal actor/Subject/resource/version/event/time/digest references; do not copy full financial payload under an audit label.
classes.basis: Approved audit purpose and minimization/retention schedule.
classes.term: Separate explicit approvedRetentionEndAt; not perpetual by default.

rules: Check current Account, Subject, purpose, resource scope, effective period and revocation before every new read/save/reopen/replay.
Revoked or expired authority denies new access immediately; a previously saved snapshot or local-contract acceptance is not an access grant.
Lawful historical retention is separate from the revoked person’s private access. Do not automatically delete retained delivery/audit records or automatically grant archive access.
Consultant departure ends access under that mandate. Any subsequent custodian/archive access needs a fresh independently approved basis.
Original product/report/entitlement behavior is not modified by this policy.

eligibility: Authenticated authorized deletion request or approved retention expiry
Exact data-class/record/version/ref scope and Subject/custodian matching
Verified retention/contract/legal-hold assessment; unknown assessment blocks formal storage/deletion, not a claim of indefinite rights
Named approver(s) and authorized executor with auditable ticket
Reviewed dependent references, deliveries, indexes, encrypted objects, backups and keys
controls: Deny normal reopen at expiry; do not mark physical deletion complete until authorized object/reference/backup scope is verified.
Where a documented hold applies, use separately authorized restricted custody, mandatory reviewAt and a defined hold exit condition; no invisible perpetual hold.
On partial failure retain minimal tombstone/audit, exact failed items and retry identity; never resurrect stale content or silently report success.
Do not treat key rotation or destruction as verified erasure without an approved key/backup scope.
No production cleanup, migration, backup deletion, grant revocation or data deletion runs in R6.2.

rules: Preserve existing R5 request identities and digests; do not retroactively change historical idempotency keys.

For any future formal contract, bind idempotency to Account/Subject/purpose/resource/request ID and the approved input/source/retention/version tuple. The exact canonical digest fields require versioned Owner approval.
An exact authorized COMPLETE request may replay its existing result; a reused key with different content is a conflict. Revocation is rechecked before returning a replay.
Use a durable unique reservation and expected-version compare-and-set/transaction in the existing Owner. No last-writer-wins or a second history store.
PENDING is not COMPLETE. Cross-process retries require bounded reservation ownership/expiry and an audited reconciliation procedure; never take over blindly.
D_idempotencyAndConcurrency.existingEvidence: R5 duplicate and same-request concurrent local saves passed; this does not prove distributed crash recovery.

rules: Preserve verified completed R5 encrypted snapshots; restart requires fresh login, current authority and exact integrity/version checks.
After interrupted save, reconcile native reservation/reference, encrypted object, checksum/AAD, Subject/source/version, retention and authorization before any approved completion.
Missing/corrupt object, inconsistent version or unknown key is a blocked recovery case; no fabricated plaintext, fallback source or synthetic COMPLETE.
A changed current source may leave the pinned snapshot historical-only; it must not silently become current evidence or trigger recomputation in place.
Key loss/rotation recovery uses a separately approved secure key/backup procedure and audit. Do not print secrets or replace the key by guessing.
Keep old Case IDs, source refs, ciphertext, checksums, report/order identities and historical versions immutable. No in-place migration from local acceptance.
Preserve the exact existing R5 reader; old snapshots remain old snapshots, not formally R6-admitted records.
Before future formal storage, approve source/Subject/grant/formula/Reading/output/locale version pins and an explicit from-version/to-version map. Current R5 formalGrantVersionPinned remains false.
Require an authorized migration plan, dry-run comparison, versioned read compatibility and per-record verification; missing old fields are explicit Unknown, not fabricated financial data.
Rollback selects the prior verified immutable version/reader. Do not overwrite original records, reinterpret old reports or erase an audit trail.
No schema migration or data transfer is executed here.

namedOutstandingDecisions.requiredEvidence: Named custodian/controller responsibility, permitted delegation and lawful source ownership; approve whether any shared enterprise custody is allowed.
Actual jurisdiction, data/record class and contract/lawful purpose; signed numeric maximum/end dates and trigger/reset rules per formal class. No legal retention period is assumed.
Revocation vs lawful retention and the independently authorized archive-access role; no residual consultant rights.
Deletion eligibility, approval/hold limits, backup/key scope, failure/retry procedure and minimal deletion audit.
Reviewed canonical idempotency/version tuple and durable atomic reservation/CAS design, with cross-process conflict/interruption evidence.
Approved PENDING/orphan/corruption/key-loss runbook, recovery approver and environment-specific verification; restart PASS alone insufficient.
Exact immutable pin schema, old/new compatibility, migration and rollback approval with verification evidence.
